map_locators.title: Top right; bilingual title and chart number
map_locators.upstream_reservoir: Main map upper-left, Kremenchutske Reservoir beyond the upstream dam; upper reach also enlarged in inset A
map_locators.downstream_reservoir: Main map lower-right, Dniprovske Reservoir beyond the Kamianske/Romankove dam end
map_locators.tributary_context: Vorskla mouth in upper-middle/right portion of main reservoir; Psel enters the upper narrow reach; Oril is separately labelled farther east
map_locators.imprint: Bottom margin; State Hydrographic Service of Ukraine, Kyiv, branch Ukrmorcartographia, 2021
map_locators.map_comparison_scope: Entire main map inspected and complete 92-position source ring compared against it with an approximate graticule registration. Insets were inspected visually only; no exact coordinate extraction from the chart.

factual_extraction: The title names the waterbody in Ukrainian and English, not merely the city or power plant.
The chart shows the named reservoir corridor between the Kremenchuk and Kamianske ends, adjoining cascade reservoirs, and tributary-mouth context.
The full supplied polygon follows the principal northwest-to-southeast impounded reach and Vorskla-mouth sector; its upper cap excludes the charted narrow continuation to Kremenchuk HPP.
Numerous charted islands, side channels, shore irregularities and some tributary-mouth extent are generalized or absent in the source polygon.
sources.coverage_limit: Supports feature-scale waterbody identity and surrounding context. Does not establish legal naming status, modern shoreline accuracy, exact containment of every polygon point, or a complete hydrologic reservoir boundary.
sources.redistribution: Raw chart and every raster derivative excluded; no open redistribution permission asserted.

sources.locator: Article body, paragraphs describing navigation-chart set 3531 and overview chart 3031; linked original overview image
factual_extraction: The chart producer identifies set 3531 as covering Kamianske Reservoir from Kremenchuk HPP to Middle Dnipro HPP and the Vorskla river mouth.
It announces overview chart 3031 at 1:100,000 and links the acquired original image.
sources.independence_note: Provenance companion to chart 3031, not counted as a second independent map.
sources.coverage_limit: Chart-set scope includes the Vorskla mouth, so its publication title alone must not be treated as a polygon boundary definition.
sources.redistribution: Raw HTML excluded; only bibliographic facts and own extraction included.

sources.locator: Dated council appeal, first substantive paragraph and closing request
factual_extraction: The council proposes changing the reservoir name from Дніпродзержинське водосховище to Кам'янське водосховище.
The same appeal separately discusses the already changed city and power-station names, showing that those changes are not themselves evidence of a completed reservoir rename.
sources.coverage_limit: Primary evidence of a proposal and historical/current-form correspondence, not an enacted naming decision or an effective date. Geographic background on this page contains Wikipedia links and is not used as an independent spatial authority.
sources.redistribution: Raw HTML excluded; only factual extraction and brief name forms included.
